name: Dairy Queen
blocked: Store-specific page for this exact location (2656 Jamacha Rd Ste 102, El Cajon, store #2639) states 'Online ordering is unavailable while this store is closed' and shows 'Store: Closed until 9:00 AM' (fetched ~3:00 AM Pacific; posted hours 9:00 AM-9:00 PM daily). This is the same recurring closed-store Olo price gate already documented in FINDINGS.md for other Dairy Queen branches (Chula Vista Treat Only, restaurantId 2333) -- the storefront blocks all item pricing while the store shows closed. The chain-wide dairyqueen.com/en-us/menu/ page only carries national promo/bundle titles ('$7 Meal Deal', '2 for $5') rather than real per-item prices for this location, so it was not used. Retry during stated trading hours (9:00 AM-9:00 PM Pacific) rather than re-queuing into another overnight wave.
notes: A different Dairy Queen branch (restaurantId 2073, Santee, store #11883) was successfully captured with 51 dishes at high confidence during open hours -- propagation may be able to reuse that by name/distance, but this specific El Cajon location was not independently priced here per the one-branch-does-not-borrow-another's-id rule.

name: Nick The Greek
notes: Restaurant's own site links to a To-Go Menu PDF (nickthegreek.com) that lists every dish, description and calories but deliberately carries no prices anywhere (confirmed both via pdftotext and a visual PDF read). The chain's own first-party ordering platforms are both client-side JS shells with no server-rendered items: orders.nickthegreek.com is a 'lunchbox-storefront' SPA, and order.thanx.com/nickthegreek is a Next.js app whose embedded Redux-ORM state has the San Diego location (id 15685, matching 927 J Street exactly) but an empty Item store -- menu items are fetched client-side after location selection. nickthegreek.orderexperience.net/san_diego/menu is a Paytronix shell, also client-rendered. Used the DoorDash marketplace listing instead (schema.org Menu JSON-LD, server-rendered, address verified to match 927 J Street, San Diego exactly). Markup test against 1.04/1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25 found no clean divisor (max 26% at 1.2), consistent with genuine pricing rather than a uniform delivery markup. Dropped the duplicate 'Most Ordered' section. Five Fries/Sides/Beverages items (Nick's Fries, Greek Fries, Side Sauce, Halloumi Fries, Celsius) showed a '+' suffix on DoorDash indicating a base/starting price for a customizable item; recorded at that base price and noted as such. Categories reached: Gyros & Pitas, Pita Combos, Bowls, Plates, Salads, Fries, Sides, Desserts, Beverages -- matches the section shape on the restaurant's own PDF (pitas, salads/bowls, plates, fries, desserts) plus combos and drinks not shown on the PDF. Catering menu and Gyro Box/Athenian/Spartan/Olympus party trays are adjuncts, excluded.
